name: fatih-toolkit
description: Fatih's Claude Code setup: a lean always-on core plus opt-in stack packs.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on core: /core:init-repo, /core:spec, /core:build, /core:ship, /core:interview, /core:token-budget; tdd, bug-hunt and source-driven skills; build-error-resolver and silent-failure-hunter agents.

plugins.name: gamedev
plugins.description: Game repos: /gamedev:setup wires the upstream gamedev skills (router + engine bundle) and optional Unity/Godot editor MCP.

plugins.name: web3d
plugins.description: Browser 3D games: web3d-stack skill (R3F, drei, Rapier, postprocessing, three.quarks, Yuka, Colyseus) with frame-budget rules.

plugins.name: ml
plugins.description: PyTorch / research repos: ml-paper-repro skill, pytorch-build-resolver and ml-reviewer agents.

plugins.name: session-log
plugins.description: Per-project handoff notes in notes/daily/ with resume-on-start and log-before-stop hooks. No-op unless notes/daily/ exists.
